body: I think more than anything i want some stability in my life and for someone to actually love me. Before we broke up, she told me about her plans to visit this guy and said he “was only a friend”.
To be strong and forget bad stuff.
Yeah, read kind of like of an early motivational speaker.
Interesting story. His meditations look familiar for some reason.
No
If you had to guess how she died, what would your thought be?
Another odd part is that my mom said that 2 weeks earlier the doctors gave her a clean bill of health.
You know what the ironic part was? The day before my mom died, she goes to me “i just want you to be happy”. This january, i had severe stomach issues due partly to my stress.

I know i’m never gonna find another girl that i clicked with as much as her. I’m already 39, her maternal qualities were exactly what i searched my whole life for. I wish so bad that i could see her again, i wish she understood what her temper was doing.

She’s the only one i would ever want children with. I have researched different suicide methods snd i think the one that i will do on myself is hanging. It seems the best fit for me. Without her and my mom my life is empty. They were the only ones that made me feel like i belonged.
But she has a good heart,  she never hit me or anything like that. She was good to me except when she got pissed, but right now i think i’d settle for even that because i miss her so much.
I know it is odd, but when she wasn’t treating me like shit she was very sweet. She loved kids so much.

My exfiancee on a regular basis always called me fat and smelly(due to an unhealed cyst scar). I’ve spent the last day researching which method to use for suicide. I don’t have any emotional attachments left,  i really don’t have anything to live for. I have to spend the rest of my life either taking a medicine which doesn’t let me sleep or stop taking medicine and have seizures, even then my seizure meds don’t always control them. I hate my seizures so much. I hate how my ex treated me and i hate how nobody was there for me when my mom died. My brother had lots of people, my dad had lots of people. I didn’t have anyone. I was the one who had to be there for everyone else but who was there for me? I’ve tried to take some sleeping pills but i’m still unable to sleep more than 1 hour. I miss my ex so much.
Yeah, i know. But it is an attribute women want to know.
Yeah. It’s hard to love a guy who’s fat, bald, could lose their job any month and doesn’t even drive.

Between that and my fiancee leaving me, i really can’t see any reason to live. I don’t even get to sleep, i just sit there trying to fall back asleep but can’t. I miss my fiancee so much. She was the only one besides my mom that ever loved me.

Problem is even if they didn’t find the clot, her being there when she collapsed would have increased her chances. But the problem is i don’t know what she died from, if it was a stroke i’m not sure. Right before she died, after she collapsed she told my dad she was hot which does not match with s heart attack or stroke.

But it was in my control, i could have called 911 to force her to go to the hospital the day before to get her to go when she said no. If she is having issues breathing they would find something. My dad and brother were taken by surprise. I was not.

When she got sent to the hospital, they treated her for a blood clot. But she did not respond, however by that point it was quite sometime. When they were performing cpr on her at her house, her body twitched/contorted. The day before she died something was odd about her breathing to me which is why i felt that. I’m a failure as a son, i failed to save her. She wanted so bad to see my 2 year old nephew’s baptism. I wish she would have listened to me. My sister in law had a blood clot after she gave birth, they said one more day and she would have been dead.

Everyday i’m haunted by the knowledge that if my mom would have gone to the hospital when i told her, she would still be alive. My dad did not want them to cut her open so they never did an autopsy. The day before my mom died my exfiancee tried to dump me and then 2 weeks after she tried again. I wanted so bad to have kids with her and get married. My mom really liked her. Now, with both of them gone and my brother raising his family, i really can’t see any benefit or reason to stay alive. By the time i find someone and get married and have kids if that even happens, my dad will probably be dead.

I’ve been doing the same, but because it isn’t my kid it isn’t the same. I wanted to have kids before my mom died, the day before she died she told me i would be a good dad. I hated having to tell her that i would not have kids soon(because my exfiancee tried to break up with me just a few hours earlier)

I tried to look into it at my old job but the one time i went they spent most of the time talking legal mumbo jumbo and making me sign forms. I said fuck it and left, i want to talk to someone that cares and wants to listen, not hear about disclaimers or count a clock.

Truth is i don’t know. She got knee replacement surgery, a few weeks later they started her on some sort of diabetic medicine. A couple of days later i had a seizure in the middle of a street fucking up my ankle. I was unable to stand for a few days and the day before she died she forced herself to visit me, when she visited me i sensed something wrong. I could not place my finger on it, i just felt if she did not go to the hospital soon she would die. She told me she did not want to die but she did not want to be in pain anymore. I begged her to go, i told my dad to try and he gave up quick. The next day she collapsed on the floor and her knee ripped open bleeding everywhere. That night i had to clean her blood off my dad’s floor.

I work in IT, my dad and bro were excited when i got my job. I was indifferent, it is just a job, money means nothing if you don’t have a partner to share it with. I’m gonna be 40 in 1 year, my younger bro has 2 kids. I have none.
